name: Potential Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
description: Detects execution of netcat with the -c/-e flag followed by a shell, a classic reverse-shell setup. Adapted from SigmaHQ. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_netcat_reverse_shell.yml, hand-converted from Sigma. Matches on process.name (the invoked basename) rather than process.executable, because Debian/Ubuntu's update-alternatives resolves nc to /usr/bin/nc.openbsd -- process.executable would silently never match "*/nc" (found via live-fire testing, see docs/build-log.md).
query: any where process.name in ("nc", "ncat") and process.title like~ ("* -c *", "* -e *") and process.title like~ ("*bash*", "*/bin/sh*", "*zsh*", "*ksh*", "*csh*", "*ash*")
author: Sentinel
